notes.title: Demo content Update - Steam Fest
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]Yesterday was the start of Steam Fest, and I'm happy to announce that Bakery Cafe Simulator is part of it![/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate the news, we're pleased to offer you [b]an exclusive content update for the game's demo[/b].[/p][p]You'll find a new beverage, the caramel latte, as well as two pieces of equipment that have been very much in demand by the community: a more efficient coffee maker allowing you to store up to 2L of coffee in advance, and a storage rack for your plates.[/p][p][/p][p][b][i]!! This content update is available exclusively on the demo and not on the prologue.[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p]In parallel, the game's development is progressing well and I'll be happy to share the progress with you very soon.[/p][p][/p][p]Wishing you a good day and a great festival![/p][p]Cédric from Meerkatt Studio[/p]

tags.feature: To celebrate the news, we're pleased to offer you [b]an exclusive content update for the game's demo[/b].

You'll find a new beverage, the caramel latte, as well as two pieces of equipment that have been very much in demand by the community: a more efficient coffee maker allowing you to store up to 2L of coffee in advance, and a storage rack for your plates.
[b][i]!! This content update is available exclusively on the demo and not on the prologue.[/i][/b]

notes.title: Prologue - Patch #07
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

New day, new patch !

For today' patch, some QoL, bugfixes and the end of griefers joining your game :
[list]
[*] Fixing an issue causing griefers to be able to join your game without having the password
[*] Clients in multiplayers had issues with edit mode
[*] You can now use Escape to exit the cash register
[*] You can now use left click to clean trays
[*] You can know set all the key binding of the game
[*] A security has been added to send you a warning if the key you try to bind is used somewhere else
[*] You can now put open boxes in the trash
[/list]

Have a nice day,

Cédric from Meerkatt Studio

notes.title: Prologue - Patch #03
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

New day, new patch !

For today' patch :

- [b]A lot of change on the performances/brightness > If you had lag, try the new "Medium" graphical settings (which is now set by default)[/b]
- Removed the multiplayer lobby, now you join directly in the game
- [b]Cash register issues with the ghost customers are normally gone[/b]

Don't hesitate to send me your feedback on the performance aspect, I'm curious to know if the game now runs better on your computer and if people who were playing on “Low” have been able to switch to “Medium” 😁🙏

Have a nice day,

Cédric from Meerkatt Studio

notes.title: Some information about what's coming next
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

First of all, I want to thank you for your interest in this prologue and your many, I read everything and try to answer as many as possible!

I've taken into account three of your recurring comments:
- Performance problems: I'm working on them and hope to be able to put a fix online by today or tomorrow, which should in theory double your FPS.
- Brightness problems: I've heard your concerns about brightness, and I hope to be able to fix this in the patch to be released today or tomorrow.
- No more cookies when you make your dough (It's a gift 👀)
- Problems in multiplayer with phantom items piling up. If you have any information that can help me with this, please feel free to come and share it on the Discord as I'm actively looking for a way to reproduce this bug to solve it...


Sorry again for the inconvenience, but I hope to be able to offer you something better very soon,

Wishing you a very good day and a pleasant moment in the game

Cédric from Meerkatt Studio

- Brightness problems: I've heard your concerns about brightness, and I hope to be able to fix this in the patch to be released today or tomorrow.

- Problems in multiplayer with phantom items piling up. If you have any information that can help me with this, please feel free to come and share it on the Discord as I'm actively looking for a way to reproduce this bug to solve it...
